episodes.description: Once known as Tony Masters, the Super Villain Taskmaster forgot his old life in order to become a prodigious savant of fighting skills. This week on Marvel 101, get ready to learn what it takes to go blow-for-blow with the best heroes in the world.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Winter Guard | Marvel 101
episodes.title: Winter Guard | Marvel 101
episodes.description: The Winter Guard are a government sponsored team of extraordinary individuals with special abilities. They fight for the people of the Russian Federation and their interests around the globe. Learn more in this week's Marvel 101!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Guardians of the Galaxy | Marvel 101
episodes.title: Guardians of the Galaxy | Marvel 101
episodes.description: This week Marvel 101 brings this group of intergalactic outlaws, turned unlikely saviors of the galaxy, who are typically without a plan and bicker constantly. But they care deeply about one another and usually get the job done, legal or otherwise.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Avengers | Marvel 101
episodes.title: Avengers | Marvel 101
episodes.description: Earth's Mightiest Heroes stand as the planet's first line of defense against the most powerful threats in the universe in this week's Marvel 101.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Doctor Strange (Stephen Strange) | Marvel 101
episodes.title: Doctor Strange (Stephen Strange) | Marvel 101
episodes.description: Formerly a renowned surgeon, Doctor Stephen Strange now serves as the Sorcerer Supreme—Earth’s foremost protector against magical and mystical threats on this week's Marvel 101.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Iron Man (Tony Stark) | Marvel 101
episodes.title: Iron Man (Tony Stark) | Marvel 101
episodes.description: Genius. Billionaire. Philanthropist. Tony Stark's confidence is only matched by his high-flying abilities as the hero called Iron Man on this week's Marvel 101.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: America Chavez | Marvel 101
episodes.title: America Chavez | Marvel 101
episodes.description: Coming to Earth from another reality, Miss America uses her super human abilities to protect its people.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Moon Girl (Lunella Lafayette) | Marvel 101
episodes.title: Moon Girl (Lunella Lafayette) | Marvel 101
episodes.description: Young genius Lunella Lafayette displays bravery beyond her years, using her vast intelligence and her telepathic link with Devil Dinosaur to become a hero. This week on Marvel 101, we’re out to protect the world through science and heart!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Devil Dinosaur | Marvel 101
episodes.title: Devil Dinosaur | Marvel 101
episodes.description: The mutated Devil Dinosaur hails from an alternate reality and is fiercely loyal to those he connects with - and a big problem for those who oppose him. This week on Marvel 101, this dino is on the move and ready to ROAR!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Silver Surfer | Marvel 101
episodes.title: Silver Surfer | Marvel 101
episodes.description: One of the noblest and most tormented cosmic entities in the universe, the Silver Surfer treasures freedom above all else, but has often sacrificed his liberty for the greater good. This week on Marvel 101, we are searching the cosmos for meaning.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Squirrel Girl (Doreen Green) | Marvel 101
episodes.title: Squirrel Girl (Doreen Green) | Marvel 101
episodes.description: Not just anyone can take on the likes of Thanos and Galactus with just a bushy tail and a positive attitude! This week on Marvel 101, get ready for the unbeatable Squirrel Girl!

series.seriesTitle: Marvel Presents: The World's Greatest Book Club With Paul Scheer

episodes.description: Paul Scheer and Steve Wacker are joined by The Star Wars Show's Anthony Carboni to talk about the latest Marvel Comics event: EMPYRE!
episodes.title: EMPYRE and BIG EVENTS with Anthony Carboni! | Worlds Greatest Book Club

episodes.description: Paul, Steve, and Jason Mantzoukas discuss the New Mutants and how living in the Marvel Universe would be super cool.
episodes.title: Living in the Marvel Universe with Jason Mantzoukas & Paul Scheer!

episodes.description: Lifelong lover of Marvel Comics, Paul Scheer and Marvel's Stephen Wacker talk 90s Spider-Man and modern X-Men with writer / actor Yassir Lester!
episodes.title: HOUSE OF X with Paul Scheer & Yassir Lester!

episodes.description: Lifelong lover of Marvel Comics, Paul Scheer and Marvel's Stephen Wacker talk with Phil Lord co-writer and director of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse! Join us for an inside look into some of Marvel's most-read classics and forgotten treasures from
episodes.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse Writer talks Spider-Ham!

episodes.description: Lifelong lover of Marvel Comics, Paul Scheer and Marvel's Stephen Wacker talk with Emmy Award winner and host of CNN's "United Shades of America" W. Kamau Bell! Join for an inside look into some of Marvel's most-read classics and forgotten treasure!
episodes.title: Paul Scheer talks IRONHEART with W. Kamau Bell! | Marvel Comics

episodes.description: Lifelong lover of Marvel Comics, Paul Scheer and Marvel's Stephen Wacker talk with special guest Gillian Jacobs about her comic book origin story which began with Power Pack! Join us for an inside look into some of Marvel's most-read classics.
episodes.title: Ms. Marvel with Paul Scheer & Community's Gillian Jacobs!

episodes.description: Join lifelong lover of Marvel Comics, Paul Scheer and special guest Damon Lindelof for an inside look into some of Marvel's most-read classics and forgotten treasures from the Marvel vault!

episodes.title: Captain Marvel | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, we are going HIGHER, FURTHER, and FASTER!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: The Unbelievable Gwenpool Holiday Special! | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: The Unbelievable Gwenpool Holiday Special! | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Unlike the usual holiday stories, this one’s not even close to a silent night. And all our super heroes know that kicking bad-guy butt and attending the hottest party of the year is the only way to truly celebrate.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Deadpool: The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Deadpool: The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, it is ALL DEADPOOL, ALL THE TIME. Forget breaking the 4th wall, we are breaking down barriers, traveling to North Korea and getting the X-gang back together! (Well, sorta. You’ll see.)

episodes.thumbnailAlt: The Dark Phoenix Saga | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: The Dark Phoenix Saga | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, Jean Grey is fighting for her life, fighting for love, and fighting… the X-Men?? Who will survive this roller-coaster ride of cosmic powers and emotions?

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Man-Thing | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Man-Thing | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: You are about to enter another world. A world not only of marvelous heroes and devastating villains, but of the dreaded Man-Thing. Come with us as we journey into the Florida swamps. Next stop, Marvel TL;DR!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Iron Man: Armor Wars | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Iron Man: Armor Wars | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Tony Stark: the man, the myth, the armor. And this week on Marvel TL;DR, that armor is going to WAR!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: The Coming of Galactus | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: The Coming of Galactus | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Galactus has worked up an appetite, and this time, it’s Earth on the menu! It’s The Coming of Galactus, so the Silver Surfer, Fantastic Four, and even the Watcher have to get in on the action this week on Marvel TL;DR!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Nova | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Nova | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Ever wonder how a helmet could make a kid a super hero? Check out Sam Alexander who followed in his father's footsteps to become the next Nova and totally save the universe - and hopefully his dad.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Spider-Gwen | TL;DR
episodes.title: Spider-Gwen | TL;DR
episodes.description: It’s hard enough being a teenager, but having to deal with high school AND all of the Kingpin’s henchmen? Almost impossible. This week on Marvel TL;DR, swing through the origins of Spider-Gwen and her fantastically complicated alternate-universe life

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Pet Avengers | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Pet Avengers | Marvel TL;DR

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Thanos Rising | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Thanos Rising | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Find out how Thanos went from a cute purple baby to one of the most destructive and sinister forces in the universe - and maybe all just to impress a girl!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: The Infinity Gauntlet | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: The Infinity Gauntlet | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This is an epic love story with an equally epic battle as one villain tries to secure the heart of his love. Follow Thanos on his quest to secure the Infinity Gems to prove his love for Mistress Death by eliminating half the life of the Universe!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Ghost Rider: Engines of Vengeance | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Ghost Rider: Engines of Vengeance | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Today, Marvel tells the story of the Engines of Vengeance! This is a story of young man trying to do good for his brother.  Follow Robbie Reyes as he finds himself with the power of Ghost Rider, which he uses to help those in his neighborhood!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: The Punisher: Welcome Back, Frank | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: The Punisher: Welcome Back, Frank | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, the Punisher takes on a crime family using extreme measures and tactical expertise! Don't mess with Frank Castle. Just...don't.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: World War Hulk | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: World War Hulk | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, someone made Hulk angry and they're going to pay.  Follow Hulk and his Warbound as they set their sights on smashing the people responsible for the destruction of Sakaar!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Weapon X | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Weapon X | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, adamantium is bonded with bone to create the fearsome Weapon X! Learn about Wolverine's days in the genetic research facility and why it's a bad idea to mix claws with bunsen burners.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: The Winter Soldier Saga | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: The Winter Soldier Saga | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This is a story about the importance of discovering your true self and why you should never trust a guy holding a glowing cube. Follow Captain America and the Winter Soldier as they dig into the past and go on an adventure of rediscovery!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Thor: Ragnarok | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Thor: Ragnarok | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Today, Marvel tells the fantastic story about Thor: Ragnarok. This is a story about forgery resulting in very bad consequences, especially when it has to do with Mjolnir. Follow Thor as he fights to save Asgard from certain destruction!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Spider-Man Versus The Vulture | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Spider-Man Versus The Vulture | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, Spider-Man encounters one of his most iconic villains for the first time: The Vulture! Relive the classic tale filled with bank robberies, epic fights, futuristic gadgetry, and...photojournalism.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: The Origin of Spider-Man | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: The Origin of Spider-Man | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, we swing back to the past to look at the origin of your friendly neighborhood Spider-Man! Relive classic high school experiences like part-time jobs, outdated fashions, and getting superpowers from irradiated arachnids!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Planet Hulk | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Planet Hulk | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This is a story about why you shouldn't mess with a giant, super-strong, easily-angered green monster. Follow Hulk as he is sent unwillingly to an alien planet, rises above life's challenges, and proves why he is the strongest there is!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Ms. Marvel: Generation Why | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Ms. Marvel: Generation Why | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Today, Marvel tells a mesmerizing story about growing up, learning to deal with change, and the benefits of befriending a large, teleporting, dog-like Inhuman. Follow Kamala Khan as she discovers new abilities and becomes Ms. Marvel!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: The Immortal Iron Fist: The Seven Capital Cities of Heaven | Marvel TL; DR
episodes.title: The Immortal Iron Fist: The Seven Capital Cities of Heaven | Marvel TL; DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, a battle for eternity rages in the heart of Heaven! Follow Iron Fist as he punches his way through Hydra with the six other Immortal Weapons.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Doctor Strange: The Oath | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Doctor Strange: The Oath | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This, friends, is a tale about the lengths a Sorcerer Supreme will go to save his magical best bro. Follow Doctor Stephen Strange as he travels through dimensions and fights gigantic demons to find the magical elixir that will cure Wong!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Deadpool Kills the Marvel Universe | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Deadpool Kills the Marvel Universe | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Today, Marvel tells the unbelievable story of Deadpool Kills the Marvel Universe. This, friends, is the tale of a single man taking on an entire universe. Follow Deadpool as he goes on a journey of self-awareness, laughter, and mayhem!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Civil War | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Civil War | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Today, Marvel tells the story about what happens when super powered beings disagree and why friendship is important. Follow Iron Man and Captain America as they ask heroes (and villains) of the Marvel Universe to take sides in a battle of beliefs!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: What is Spider-Verse? | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: What is Spider-Verse? | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Today, Marvel tells the hair-raising story of Spider-Verse. This, friends, is a story about embracing one's destiny... or multiple destinies... from multiple universes. Follow ALL the Spider characters as they team-up to save destiny itself!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Avengers | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Avengers | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Today, Marvel TL;DR goes Cosmic with everybody’s favorite space-faring misfits, the Guardians of the Galaxy! Witness the emotional struggle between a father and son, the complexity of intergalactic politics, and a thinking tree get eaten by a whale!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Fantastic Four: The Inhumans Among Us | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Fantastic Four: The Inhumans Among Us | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, the Inhumans arrive on Earth and meet the Fantastic Four! Massive super-powered fights. Star-crossed lovers. A humongous teleporting (and super adorable) dog. This classic Marvel story is bigger than even Galactus himself!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Avengers Versus  X-Men | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Avengers Versus  X-Men | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, the salvation of Mutant-kind could also bring the destruction of Earth! Discover what happens when two of the Marvel Universe's most powerful teams goes head-to-head in a battle for all they hold dear.

episodes.thumbnailAlt: The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, Doreen Green (aka Squirrel Girl) fights an evil squirrel with mind control powers called Ratatoskr! And of course she wins! Because she's the best!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Daredevil Yellow | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Daredevil Yellow | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, we revisit Matt Murdock's early years as the hero, Daredevil! This tale of friendship, love, and responsibility shows us the true origins of the Man Without Fear. At that time...dressed in the color yellow!

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Who is the Black Panther? | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Who is the Black Panther? | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: This week on Marvel TL;DR, the mantle of the Black Panther finds a worthy new home with T'Challa as he fights to avenge his father! Journey into the vibrant and lush nation of Wakanda to find out "Who is the Black Panther?"

episodes.thumbnailAlt: Runaways | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.title: Runaways | Marvel TL;DR
episodes.description: Parents and their children don't get along! Join Alex, Nico, Karolina, Gertrude (and Old Lace), Chase and Molly as they go on an adventure of self-discovery in a tale about growing up with parents that are super-powered villains. Kids today, amirite?

She-Hulk is decked out in all her green glory, but this week on Marvel TL;DR, it’s not about that vigilante hero spirit and living life on the edge. Nope! Instead Jen’s going to prove that all those student loans were worth it and show off what she d
episodes.title: She-Hulk: Law and Disorder | Marvel TL;DR
